item.tib: ma mo spyir rgyud gces pa'i gnad rgyud yig sna
item.coloph: ma mo spyir rgyud gces pas (pa'i) gnad rgyud yig sna 'di/ bla ma dam pa'i zhal gdam/ mo ting bdag gis lag len yin/ ma tang mtshams pa la/ sa le 'od kyis zhus/ de nas rim gyis brgyud nas bdag la'o/ phyi rabs dar rgyas bstan pa 'phel ba dang / bon skyong gnyen pos bstan pa srung bar shog/
